$comment: Canonical verdict/finding registry — the single grading vocabulary for the unified turn-drive harness (Phase 0.2, stability-and-scalability-plan.md). Every code the framework scoring gates, the widget exportGrader red-flags, and the connector eval Checks can produce maps to ONE canonical code here via `aliases`. A finding fires when something is WRONG (a gate failed / a red-flag tripped / an assertion failed); `default_severity` sets how hard it bites. Severity: block (hard FAIL) | warn (DEGRADED under soft gate, FAIL under strict) | info (recorded, never blocks) | skip (not applicable). `lever` points at what to edit to fix it (ported from framework levers.py). Sources: framework | connector-eval | widget.
